verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents a built-in AI Assistant that can read threads, write drafts, search email history, and check your calendar. It also runs multi-app workflows through built-in integrations and MCP, browses the web, analyzes files, remembers preferences, and acts on triggers when emails arrive. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the assistant's delegated-task performance, since all evidence is vendor-claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: It’s incredibly capable: it can read threads, write drafts, search your entire email history, check your calendar, and more.
connects our AI Assistant to all your business applications, letting you accomplish complex workflows without ever leaving your inbox.
Set up triggers to draft replies when emails arrive, add comments for your team, organize threads into todos, and connect to 3,000+ other apps.
Customize the behavior of your AI assistant by asking it to remember facts & preferences
